class RelativeURIResolver(_BaseHTMLProcessor):
    relative_uris = {
        ('a', 'href'),
        ('applet', 'codebase'),
        ('area', 'href'),
        ('audio', 'src'),
        ('blockquote', 'cite'),
        ('body', 'background'),
        ('del', 'cite'),
        ('form', 'action'),
        ('frame', 'longdesc'),
        ('frame', 'src'),
        ('iframe', 'longdesc'),
        ('iframe', 'src'),
        ('head', 'profile'),
        ('img', 'longdesc'),
        ('img', 'src'),
        ('img', 'usemap'),
        ('input', 'src'),
        ('input', 'usemap'),
        ('ins', 'cite'),
        ('link', 'href'),
        ('object', 'classid'),
        ('object', 'codebase'),
        ('object', 'data'),
        ('object', 'usemap'),
        ('q', 'cite'),
        ('script', 'src'),
        ('source', 'src'),
        ('video', 'poster'),
        ('video', 'src'),
    }

    def __init__(self, baseuri, encoding, _type):
        _BaseHTMLProcessor.__init__(self, encoding, _type)
        self.baseuri = baseuri

    def resolve_uri(self, uri):
        return make_safe_absolute_uri(self.baseuri, uri.strip())

    def unknown_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs = self.normalize_attrs(attrs)
        attrs = [(key, ((tag, key) in self.relative_uris) and self.resolve_uri(value) or value) for key, value in attrs]
        super(RelativeURIResolver, self).unknown_starttag(tag, attrs)
